units.source_text: 北山的杉林层层叠叠，漫空茏翠，宛如云层一般。

en.t: The cedar forests of Kitayama rose in layer upon layer, filling the sky with deep green, like banks of clouds.

units.source_text: 山上还有一行行赤杉，它的树干纤细，线条清晰，

en.t: On the mountain there were also rows of red cedars, their trunks slender and their outlines sharply defined,

units.source_text: 整座山林像一个乐章，送来了悠长的林声……

en.t: and the whole mountain forest seemed like a piece of music, sending forth a long, lingering sound of trees...
